page: Dev Helper for development utilities. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {getRouterName, showRoutes} from 'hono/dev'. Functions: getRouterName(app) returns router name string. showRoutes(app, options) displays registered routes in console. Output format: METHOD /path showing HTTP method and route path. Includes: basePath in output. Options: verbose (boolean, default false, show verbose info), colorize (boolean, default true, color output). Use cases: debugging, development, route introspection. Example: showRoutes(app, {verbose: true}) displays all routes with details. Console output: each route on separate line with method and path. Questions: How to get router name? How to see all routes? What's verbose? How to disable colors?

sections.manifest: getRouterName() function for router identification. Returns: current router name string. Usage: getRouterName(app) where app is Hono instance. Example: console.log(getRouterName(app)). Development only: used to identify which router implementation. Questions: What's the router name? How to get it?

showRoutes() function for displaying registered routes. Displays: all routes in console output. Format: METHOD /path per line like 'GET /v1/posts'. Usage: showRoutes(app, {verbose: true}). Includes: basePath in output paths. Example: app.basePath('/v1') shows routes with /v1 prefix. Output colors: by default, can be disabled. Development tool: debugging and route inspection. Questions: How to show routes? What's output format? Does basePath work? How verbose?

showRoutes options specification. Optional: verbose (boolean, default false, displays verbose information). Optional: colorize (boolean, default true, colors console output). When verbose: true shows additional detail. When colorize: false shows plain text. Questions: What options available? What does verbose do? Can I disable colors?
